title: TSD Daily — Thursday, August 20, 2026
summary: Stripe buys OpenRouter for a reported $7.5 billion and Binance lets AI agents trade with no loss cap; a CVSS 9.8 WordPress form-plugin flaw still sits unpatched on 300,000 sites; Walmart raises guidance on the back of a $2.9 billion tariff refund; and the July Fed minutes show three dissents that all wanted a hike.
